overview_description.description:
LegalZoom is the nation's most recognized name in law, the alternative to the traditional law firm.  

The leading provider of online legal document services and legal plans to families and small businesses, LegalZoom offers high quality, affordable legal services, marrying cutting-edge technology with access to experienced attorneys. LegalZoom was founded on the idea that all Americans deserve access to the law;  and as of 2011 the company has helped close to two million small businesses and families with their legal needs.  Our high quality documents have been accepted in all 50 states, and 94% of customers would refer LegalZoom to their family and friends.

product.name: Business Formation Services
product.description: Online services for forming LLCs, corporations, nonprofits, sole proprietorships, and DBAs, including preparation and submission of formation documents to government agencies.

product.name: Business Compliance and Operations Services
product.description: Services that help businesses manage ongoing legal and administrative requirements, including annual reports, business licenses, EINs, operating agreements, registered agents, virtual mail, credit, and dissolution.

product.name: Intellectual Property Services
product.description: Online services for trademark registration and searches, trademark monitoring, provisional patent applications, and copyright registration to help businesses document and protect intellectual property.

product.name: Attorney Plans and Legal Services
product.description: Access to independent attorneys for business and personal legal matters, including attorney plans and separately scoped legal services with upfront pricing and attorney consultations.

product.name: Estate Planning Services
product.description: Online estate planning products for creating wills, living trusts, powers of attorney, and healthcare directives.

product.name: Legal Document and Contract Tools
product.description: Self-service legal document tools, including customizable templates, electronic signatures, and Doc Assist AI for preparing or working with legal documents.
